public.title: Asteroid Collision
public.description: Each nonzero signed integer is an asteroid: magnitude is size, sign is direction on a line. Adjacent right-moving and left-moving asteroids collide; smaller disappears, equal sizes both disappear. Return survivors in their original order. There are 0 to 500 asteroids, magnitudes 1 to 1000.
hints: Use a stack of surviving asteroids.
Only a positive stack top and negative incoming value can collide.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Each asteroid enters and leaves the stack at most once. Resolve collisions until the incoming asteroid is destroyed or cannot meet the top. Time and space are O(n).
